diagnostics.parse_rule: Minimum edges, then lexicographically smallest complete edge-id sequence
diagnostics.rank_sort: Descending log(P0(letter))+log(weight/52), then ascending slot id
diagnostics.repair_rule: Each attempt starts at rank_slots; one continuous Random(2200022); 414 moves: role=randrange(3), i=randrange(138); P/S swap i with randrange(138); U nonduplicate i swaps with choice(sorted nonduplicate slots); U duplicate i relocates both copies to randrange(23), sample(range(6),2), moving displaced unique atoms in ascending position order
